description:
Add three HTTP security headers to the Apache virtual host configuration for the 'globex.test' virtual server. 

Goal: Navigate to the Apache configuration for 'globex.test' in Virtualmin (often found under Services > Configure Website > Edit Directives) and add the following headers:
1. X-Content-Type-Options: "nosniff"
2. X-Frame-Options: "SAMEORIGIN"
3. Strict-Transport-Security: "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"

Ensure that you save the configuration and that the changes are applied (Apache reloaded). Verification will check both the configuration file and the live HTTP response headers.
